title: University Orders 58,000 Students to Retake Exam After AI Failure
subtitle: A major Mexican university is restarting its entrance process after remote testing software led to suspicious results.

summary.en: UNAM, the largest university in Mexico, has ordered 58,000 students to retake their entrance exam. This decision follows a failed attempt to use AI-powered software to watch students during remote testing. Results from the exam showed a suspiciously high number of top scores compared to previous years. Experts believe the AI system did not work as intended, leading to widespread concerns about cheating. The university now requires an in-person test to ensure fairness for all applicants.
summary.zh: 墨西哥規模最大的大學墨西哥國立自治大學，已要求五萬八千名學生重考入學考試。這項決定是在嘗試使用人工智慧軟體於遠端測驗期間監控學生失敗後所做出的。考試結果顯示，與往年相比，獲得高分的學生人數多得令人懷疑。專家認為人工智慧系統未如預期運作，導致外界對作弊問題產生廣泛疑慮。校方現在要求進行實體考試，以確保所有申請者的公平性。

paragraphs.en: Thousands of students hoping to join Mexico’s largest university, UNAM, are facing an unexpected challenge. Following a failed remote testing process earlier this summer, the university has announced that 58,000 applicants must sit for a new, in-person exam. This decision comes after an investigation revealed that the AI-powered software used to monitor students during the original test did not work correctly.
paragraphs.zh: 數千名希望能進入墨西哥規模最大的大學——墨西哥國立自治大學（UNAM）的學生，正面臨一項意想不到的挑戰。在今年夏天稍早的遠端測驗過程失敗後，校方宣布五萬八千名申請者必須參加一場新的實體考試。這項決定是在一項調查顯示，用於在原始測驗期間監控學生的人工智慧軟體運作失靈後所做出的。

paragraphs.en: Earlier this year, nearly 160,000 people took the UNAM entrance exam from their own homes. To prevent cheating, the university used a special web browser and software that used artificial intelligence to watch students through their webcams. This was the first time the school had used such technology for the entire process. However, when the results were released, they were very different from what the school had seen in the past.
paragraphs.zh: 今年稍早，近十六萬名考生在家中參加了墨西哥國立自治大學的入學考試。為了防止作弊，校方使用了一種特殊的網頁瀏覽器與軟體，透過人工智慧經由網路攝影機監控學生。這是該校首次在整個過程中採用此類技術。然而，當成績公布時，結果與校方過去所見的情況大相逕庭。

paragraphs.en: According to Ars Technica, the number of students achieving top scores rose sharply. Between 2021 and 2025, only about 3.5 percent of students scored 100 or more on the 120-question test. This year, that number jumped to 16.3 percent. The results were even more unusual at the very top level, where the percentage of students scoring 110 or higher increased significantly compared to previous years. These strange results led to widespread accusations that students had cheated during the remote exam.
paragraphs.zh: 根據科技新聞網站 Ars Technica 報導，獲得高分的學生人數急劇上升。在二零二一年至二零二五年之間，這項一百二十題的測驗中，僅約百分之三點五的學生獲得一百分或以上。今年，該比例躍升至百分之十六點三。在頂尖成績的層級中，結果更顯異常，獲得一百一十分或以上的學生比例與往年相比顯著增加。這些奇怪的結果引發了廣泛的指控，認為學生在遠端考試期間作弊。

paragraphs.en: In response to these concerns, UNAM created a special group of experts to investigate the situation. This group, which included many professionals, recently finished its report. They concluded that the only way to make sure the process was fair was to hold a new test. This is known as a “control exam”—a test used to check or confirm the results of a previous one. The university decided that all students who were originally accepted based on their scores must now prove their knowledge again in person.
paragraphs.zh: 針對這些疑慮，墨西哥國立自治大學成立了一個專家小組來調查此情況。這個包含許多專業人士的小組近期完成了報告。他們斷定，確保過程公平的唯一方法就是舉行一場新的測驗。這被稱為「對照考試」，即用於檢查或確認先前測驗結果的考試。校方決定，所有原本根據成績錄取的學生，現在必須親自到場再次證明他們的實力。

paragraphs.en: This is a difficult situation for many young people. The university rector, who is the head of the school, has publicly apologized to the students who studied hard and did not cheat. He noted that it is unfair to make honest students take the test again. However, he explained that the new exam is necessary to give certainty and guarantee equity, which means fairness and equal opportunity for everyone, in the university’s admission process.
paragraphs.zh: 對許多年輕人來說，這是一個艱難的處境。身為學校最高負責人的校長已公開向那些努力學習且未作弊的學生致歉。他指出，要求誠實的學生重考是不公平的。然而，他解釋說，這場新的考試對於在大學入學過程中提供確定性並確保公平性（意即對每個人而言的公正與平等機會）是必要的。

paragraphs.en: This update follows earlier reports that the remote exam system had failed to provide reliable results. The university is now working quickly to organize the new testing schedule. With classes originally set to begin on August 10, the school faces a very tight deadline to complete the testing and finalize the list of new students. It remains unclear if the start date for the new school year will be delayed to accommodate this change.
paragraphs.zh: 這項更新是在先前有報導指出遠端考試系統未能提供可靠結果後所發布的。校方目前正加緊腳步安排新的考試時程。由於課程原定於八月十日開始，學校面臨極為緊迫的期限來完成測驗並敲定新生名單。目前尚不清楚新學年的開學日期是否會為了配合這項變動而延後。

paragraphs.en: This event highlights the risks of moving important exams to remote, AI-supervised systems. While technology can sometimes make processes easier, it can also create new problems if the systems are not fully tested or secure. For now, the students of UNAM must prepare for one more test, hoping that this time, the process will be fair and accurate for everyone involved. The university has promised to provide more details about the upcoming control exam soon, as thousands of families wait to hear how this will affect their future education.
paragraphs.zh: 此事件凸顯了將重要考試轉移至遠端、由人工智慧監控系統進行的風險。雖然科技有時能讓流程更簡便，但如果系統未經充分測試或不夠安全，也可能產生新的問題。目前，墨西哥國立自治大學的學生必須為另一場考試做準備，並希望這一次的過程對所有相關人員而言是公平且準確的。校方已承諾很快會提供更多關於即將到來的對照考試細節，而數千個家庭正等待了解這將如何影響他們的未來教育。

keyTerms.noteZh: sit 常見作「坐」，這裡與 for 連用表示參加考試。文中：the university has announced that 58,000 applicants must sit for a new, in-person exam.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To increase suddenly and by a large amount.
keyTerms.noteZh: jump 常見作「跳躍」，這裡用來形容數據的急劇上升。文中：This year, that number jumped to 16.3 percent.
tight 常見作「緊的」，這裡形容時間安排非常吃緊。文中：the school faces a very tight deadline to complete the testing and finalize the list of new students.

previousArticles.title: AI Exam System Failure Forces 58,000 Students to Retake Test
previousArticles.summaryEn: Nearly 160,000 students took a remote entrance exam for UNAM, Mexico's largest university, earlier this summer. The exam used new AI-powered software to watch students through their webcams. However, the results showed a strange and very large increase in high scores compared to previous years. Experts investigated the situation and concluded that the results were not reliable. Now, 58,000 students must take a new, in-person exam to ensure fairness for everyone. The university has apologized for the trouble this causes to honest students.

quiz.question: What change in student performance triggered the university's investigation into the remote exam?

options.A: A decrease in the total number of students who completed the 120-question test.
options.B: A significant increase in the percentage of students achieving high scores compared to previous years.
options.C: A failure of the university's web browser to load the test for 58,000 applicants.
options.D: A report stating that 160,000 students were unable to access their webcams during the exam.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第三段，數據顯示獲得高分的學生比例從過去的 3.5% 飆升至 16.3%，這種異常的成績分布導致了作弊的指控。選項 A 與事實相反，文中並未提到考試完成人數減少；選項 C 將原因搞錯了，軟體故障是調查後的結果，而非起因；選項 D 則完全未在文中提及。

quiz.question: Based on the information provided, what can be inferred about the university's AI-powered monitoring software?

options.A: It was highly successful in preventing cheating during the first exam.
options.B: It was designed by the university rector to save money on physical testing centers.
options.C: It failed to perform its intended function of ensuring test integrity.
options.D: It was the first time students had ever used webcams for an academic purpose.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第一段與第三段，學校使用 AI 是為了防止作弊，但結果卻出現異常高分，且調查證實軟體運作不正常，因此可推論該軟體未能達到維護考試公正性的目的。選項 A 錯誤，因為結果顯示作弊疑慮很高；選項 B 文中未提及成本考量；選項 D 過度推論，文中僅提到這是學校首次使用此技術進行「整個過程」，而非學生首次使用視訊鏡頭。

quiz.question: In the fifth paragraph, what does the word 'equity' mean in the context of the university's admission process?

options.A: The financial cost of attending the university.
options.B: The fairness and equal opportunity for all applicants.
options.C: The speed at which the university processes student applications.
options.D: The academic difficulty of the entrance examination.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。文中第五段明確解釋了 'equity' 的定義，即 'fairness and equal opportunity for everyone'。選項 A、C、D 均與文中提供的定義不符，且 equity 在此處指涉的是入學過程的公平性，而非金錢、速度或考試難度。

quiz.question: What is the primary message of the article?

options.A: UNAM is permanently switching to remote testing to modernize its admission process.
options.B: The university rector is resigning due to the failure of the AI software.
options.C: Students are protesting against the university's decision to hold a second exam.
options.D: The failure of an AI-supervised remote exam has forced a university to require a new in-person test to ensure fairness.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。這篇文章的核心在於報導 UNAM 大學因遠端 AI 監考系統失效，導致成績異常，進而決定要求學生重新進行實體考試以確保公平性。選項 A 與事實相反，學校正轉回實體測試；選項 B 文中未提及校長辭職；選項 C 雖提到學生面臨困難，但並未描述學生抗議的行動，僅描述了學校的決策與背景。
